author: Agent39
purpose: Resolve all English-display XYP rows in the authenticated Aichi Top 32 roster to pre-event Japanese printings with matching card text.

cards.name: Jirachi

availability.basis: Official Japanese card page identifies Promotion Card Pack (2015/5).

cards.notes: Official Japanese page gives the same two attack names and effects as English XYP #67.

cards.name: Regirock

availability.basis: Official Japanese card page identifies the CoroCoro Ichiban! February 2015 issue insert; exact distribution day is not stated on that page.

cards.notes: Official Japanese page gives the same Ancient Trait and attack effects as English XYP #49. These two ranks remain incompatible for separate Japanese-only promo cards; this crosswalk does not change that.

cards.name: Karen

availability.basis: Official Pokémon Card Gym Karen Night Battle page states that Karen was the participation prize throughout this period.

matching_text: Supporter: each player shuffles all Pokémon in their discard pile into their deck.
cards.notes: Official Japanese card page identifies 256/XY-P and the same effect as English XYP #177; official event page confirms the card was distributed before the Aichi event.

established: Every XYP source row in the 29 authenticated lists maps to one of these three English Expanded-legal identities.
A Japanese print with matching text existed before 2026-05-10 for each identity.
The nine XYP rows and twelve copies are no longer unresolved solely because the English XYP set has no release date in the chronology registry.
not_established: Which exact physical Japanese copy each player registered or used.
A full physical-print audit of every non-XYP card in any list.
Expanded legality of ranks 3 and 7, which contain separate Japanese-only promo identities.
